_doc: The AI 2027 scenario's own research-speed figures (its 'AI R&D progress multiplier': how much faster the leading lab makes algorithmic progress than it would without AI). Quotes are from ai-2027.com. Dates use the same one-day convention as predictions.json. Between figures the multiplier is interpolated on a log scale; the scenario names no figure for April 2025, so publication is anchored at 1x (no AI speed-up). After the last figure the rate is held flat, because the scenario's next stated figures come later than this chart reaches.
title: AI 2027
authors: Daniel Kokotajlo, Scott Alexander, Thomas Larsen, Eli Lifland, Romeo Dean
